thread:
samira: Quick question—I9m deaf and I9d like to request an ASL interpreter for recurring customer calls and live captions for internal prep meetings. Also need guidance on recording/accessibility of the call notes (customers sometimes record). Is this something People Ops coordinates or is it on my manager?

lucas (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, @samira. We absolutely support this. People Ops can coordinate vendor interpreters and captioning. A few quick items: 1) please fill the "Communication Access" form so we can log and budget it; 2) we9ll need the recurring meeting invites and time windows to source an interpreter; 3) we9ll work with legal on any recording/privacy constraints. We treat these requests confidentially.

adie (Manager): Happy to help with scheduling. Samira—can you paste the list of recurring calls (day/time + customer) here or DM me? I9ll mark them as high priority so we can get vendor time locked.
a11y_bot: Tip: For customer-sensitive calls, request interpreter access via the vendor portal and mark the event as "customer non-recording" if the customer agrees; if customers insist on recording, Legal will advise on interpreter NDAs. Link: https://redwood.internal/accessibility/vendors
samira: Thanks all. I posted the list in a DM to @adie. One more ask: for product demos, I prefer a short pre-brief (10m) with the interpreter so they can prep terminology—can we include that in the coordination?
lucas (People Ops): Absolutely. We9ll request a 10-minute prep window before each session. Budget: People Ops covers reasonable interpreter costs; if sessions fall outside normal business hours we9ll confirm overtime rates. Action: I9ll submit the accommodation entry and loop in Legal for the recording question.
adie (Manager): I9ll update the invites with a private note about the prep window and block the 10m. Samira—do you want calendar invites CC9d to the interpreter email or should People Ops handle adding them privately?
samira: Please have People Ops add them privately to avoid exposing contact info. Also confirming this is not a performance issue—I9m just requesting access.
lucas (People Ops): Confirmed: accommodation only; no adverse performance implication. We9ll create a private note tied to this accommodation. Expected turnaround: vendor match within 3 business days after form submission. I9ll follow up via DM with next steps and the form link.
a11y_bot: Action logged: communication-access-request created for samira (start: 2225000000). Notifications to People Ops, manager, Legal.
samira: Thank you all—appreciate the quick help :)
